subject: future
topic: Students with an AI tutor: learning more, or just finishing faster?
angle: While AI tools can significantly boost scores during practice, unfettered access can cause students to use them as a crutch, leading to worse performance once the tools are removed.
title: The AI Learning Paradox

hooks.text: Are you actually learning the material?
You get higher scores but lower skills.
You are using AI as a crutch.
A cursor blinks on a blank page.

reveal.headline: Removing AI access causes a 17% grade drop.
reveal.body: Students who used GPT-4 perform worse than those who never had access. This result is mixed and depends on how the tool is used.

explain.headline: AI creates a performance gap.
explain.body: Access to GPT-4 can improve performance by 127% for some. However, without proper design, the tool becomes a crutch that hinders actual skill acquisition.

matters.headline: Your progress may be an illusion.
matters.body: That may be why your scores go up while your understanding stays flat. You might be learning how to use the tool rather than the subject.

example.headline: The laptop glows in a dark room.
example.body: You stare at a complex math problem. You prompt the screen. The answer appears instantly. You move to the next one without thinking about the first.

question.headline: Are you learning or just finishing?

stat.label: reduction in grades for students when GPT-4 access is removed

claims.text: When access to GPT-4 is taken away, students perform worse than those who never had access, with a 17% reduction in grades for GPT Base.
claims.quote: we additionally find that when access is subsequently taken away, students actually perform worse than those who never had access (17% reduction in grades for GPT Base)

claims.text: Having GPT-4 access while solving problems makes performance improve by 48% for GPT Base and 127% for GPT Tutor.
claims.quote: our results show that having GPT-4 access while solving problems significantly improves performance (48% improvement in grades for GPT Base and 127% for GPT Tutor).

verdict: The evidence shows that AI can improve immediate performance and proficiency, but without proper guardrails or pedagogical design, it can hinder the actual acquisition of skills.
caveat: The effectiveness of AI tools varies significantly depending on factors like tool functionality, course design, and the presence of specific safeguards.
caption:
AI tools can significantly boost your immediate scores. 

Research shows that while GPT-4 can improve performance by up to 127%, removing the tool can lead to a 17% drop in grades compared to those who never used it. The effectiveness depends on the specific safeguards and course design. 

Is your progress real or just a shortcut?
